--- title: "Normal Distribution" format: revealjs: scrollable: true theme: solarized # moon transition: slide footer: "dplyr and data.table" slide-number: c include-after-body: clean_title_page.html fontsize: 25pt highlight-style: github execute: echo: true warning: false message: false freeze: auto fig-align: "center" fig-width: 6 fig-height: 4 editor: markdown: wrap: 72 --- # Normal Distribution ## Mathematical notation $$ f(x; \mu, \sigma) = \frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{2\pi}} e^{-\frac{(x - \mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}} $$ Where: - $x$ is the random variable. - $\mu$ is the mean of the distribution. - $\sigma$ is the standard deviation of the distribution. ## Sample from Normal Distribution - generate a sample from a Gaussian distribution: ```rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)``` **Example:** ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} y <- rnorm(n = 100000, mean = 5, sd = sqrt(2)) hist(y, freq = F, ylim = c(0, 0.3)) curve(dnorm(x, mean = 5, sd = sqrt(2)), col = 2, add = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: :::
## Density function (pdf) of Normal Distribution Calculate pdf of Normal distribution: - ```dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1)``` ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} y <- rnorm(n = 100000, mean = 0,sd = 1) hist(y, freq=F, ylim = c(0, 0.4),breaks = 100) dnorm(-1) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.2419707 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} hist(y, freq = F, ylim = c(0, 0.4), breaks = 100) abline(v = -1, lty = 2) abline(h = dnorm(-1), lty=2) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: ## Cumullative Density function (cdf) of Normal Distribution Calculate pdf of Normal distribution: - ```pnorm(q, mean = 0, sd = 1)``` ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tigerstats) pnorm(-1) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1586553 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(-1, region = "below", graph = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1586553 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} plot(ecdf(y),main = "Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function") abline(v= quantile(ecdf(y),0.158655254), lty = 2) abline(h= pnorm(-1), lty = 2) text(x = -0.15, y = 0.2,labels = "(-1,0.159)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-3-2.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: ## Quantiles of Normal Distribution - ```qnorm(p, mean = 0, sd = 1)``` ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} qnorm(0.158655254) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] -1 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} quantile(ecdf(y),0.158655254) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 15.86553% -1.002388 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} plot(ecdf(y), main = "Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function") abline(v = quantile(ecdf(y), 0.158655254), lty = 2) abline(h = pnorm(-1), lty = 2) text(x = -0.15, y = 0.2,labels = "(-1,0.159)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: :::
# EXAMPLES ## Consider $X \sim N(0,1)$. It is very easy to compute the following probabilities with R: - $P(X \le 0.89)$ ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} pnorm(0.89) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.8132671 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(0.89, region="below",graph=T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.8132671 ``` ::: ::: ## - $P(X \ge 1.21)$ ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} #| fig-align: "center" 1-pnorm(1.21) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1131394 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(1.21, region="above",graph=T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1131394 ``` ::: ::: ## - $P(-1.02 \le X \le 1.98)$ ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} pnorm(1.98)-pnorm(-1.02) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.822284 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(c(-1.02,1.98), region="between",graph=T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.822284 ``` ::: ::: ## - $P(\mid X \mid \le 0.92)$ ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} pnorm(0.92)-pnorm(-0.92) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.6424272 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(c(-0.92,0.92), region="between",graph=T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.6424272 ``` ::: ::: ## - $P(\mid X \mid \ge 1.11)$ ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} (1-pnorm(1.11))+pnorm(-1.11) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.266999 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pnormGC(c(-1.11,1.11), region="outside",graph=T) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](normal_distribution_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){fig-align='center' width=576} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.266999 ``` ::: :::

## OTHER DISTRIBUTIONS We can use other distributions like the Normal distribution, for example - binomial: rbinom, dbinom, pbinom, qbinom - uniform: runif, dunif, punif, qunif - Student's t: rt, dt, pt, qt - ...

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
